spec.prompt: Exterior, re-entry, wide shot: the spherical Voskhod-2 descent capsule alone (the ball-shaped cabin from the reference, about two metres across, with no airlock and no equipment module attached) falls into the upper atmosphere high above the curved dark Earth. A pink-orange plasma sheath builds on its leading side and brightens to orange-white; a long glowing trail streams out behind it across the sky. The capsule is small in the lower-middle of frame; the upper half of the frame stays black sky. Camera tracks alongside, steady. Photorealistic, shot on 35mm film, IMAX documentary realism in the spirit of Apollo 11 (2019) and Gravity. Accurate 1965 Soviet hardware: the white Berkut spacesuit with rust-orange harness straps, a white helmet with red CCCP letters above the visor, Soviet markings only. Hard directional sunlight, deep black space, crisp silhouettes. No on-screen text, no captions.
